short_description: Agyaat is a first-person single-player horror game where you play as Acharya, drawn into the haunted depths of Ambika’s House to uncover a dark truth buried in Indian folklore. Explore, survive, and piece together the mansion’s twisted past — but beware, the house remembers every step you take.
